title: Royal Decor Company Alternative: Decorative Finishes
description: Comparing Royal Decor Company and Precision Paint Experts for limewash, venetian plaster, or metallic finishes? What to ask about samples and low-VOC options.
h1: Royal Decor Company vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: Decorative finishes reward careful sampling and a clear written plan. This guide explains how to compare proposals for limewash, plaster, and metallic work.

questions: What is the difference between limewash and venetian plaster?
How do I choose a decorative paint finish for a room?

body: Royal Decor Company is one of the companies North Central Florida homeowners and businesses may be considering for interior work, and Precision Paint Experts is another option. We do not describe other businesses. This page focuses on decorative and faux finishes, where results depend on technique and on agreeing exactly what the finished wall will look like before anyone starts.
Unlike flat color, a textured or layered finish varies with the hand that applies it. That makes samples, written specifications, and a clear review process the heart of any comparison.

Precision Paint Experts offers limewash, venetian plaster, and metallic finishes through our decorative and faux finishes service. Limewash gives a soft, mottled, matte look with natural movement. Venetian plaster is built up in thin layers and burnished for depth and a subtle sheen. Metallics add reflective shimmer, often on accent walls, ceilings, or feature areas in restaurants and retail spaces.
Each sits differently in a room, and our article on choosing the right finish for any room helps match the look to how the space is used.

Decorative finishes are not limited to walls. Ceilings, range hoods, columns, and fireplace surrounds can all carry a plaster or metallic treatment, and a small feature area is a good way to try a finish before committing a whole room. Whatever the scope, the estimate should name exactly which surfaces will receive the decorative finish and which will be painted in standard color.

sections.h2: Questions to settle before decorative work begins
body: Ask any contractor to answer these:
bullets: Will I see a full-size sample in my chosen colors before work starts?
Is the finish type, color, and sheen written on the estimate?
What prep does the wall need first, such as drywall repair or priming?
Are low-VOC products available for occupied rooms?
How are small touch-ups handled later?

sections.h2: How we plan a decorative finish
body: We start with color: matching from a chip or an existing surface and producing full-size drawdowns for review. Our color consultation can help when you have a direction but not a final palette. Walls are prepared first, with any damage handled through drywall repair, so the finish is not telegraphing patches.

Low-VOC and eco-conscious options are available, which helps in homes, offices, and restaurants that stay open. Clients do not need to leave the home, and crews protect furniture and work room by room. Commercial spaces can be scheduled around operating hours.

Lighting changes how a textured finish reads, so it is worth reviewing samples under the room's own lamps and daylight. A limewash wall that looks soft at noon can look more dramatic in evening light, and we would rather you see that before the walls are done.

Bring photos of finishes you like to the walkthrough. The written estimate lists surfaces, prep, products, and schedule, and anything not right at the final walkthrough is fixed before close-out. Request a free estimate, or see our retail and restaurant painting service for commercial interiors.

faqs.q: Do you apply venetian plaster and limewash?
faqs.a: Yes. Our decorative finishes include limewash, venetian plaster, and metallics.

faqs.q: Can I see the finish before you do the whole room?
faqs.a: We produce full-size drawdowns so you can judge color and finish at a realistic scale before work begins.

faqs.q: Are there low-VOC options for decorative work?
faqs.a: Yes. Low-VOC and eco-conscious material options are available.
